old: Move focus to the scope tab strip with Tab, then cycle tabs with Left and Right arrows
new: Press Tab to reach the search tabs, then Left and Right arrows switch tabs

old: The clear control appears only once you type, and empties the box without closing
new: The clear (x) button appears once you type and empties the search box

old: The scope tab strip lists All plus the eight entity tabs in the exact order
new: Search tabs read All, then the eight record types in a fixed order

old: Selecting a scope tab shows only that entity's results with its count
new: Clicking a search tab shows only that type of record, with its count

old: No Contacts tab or group appears; a contact match returns its company
new: Searching a contact's name finds its company (there is no Contacts tab)

old: Clicking 'Show all N' switches the modal to that entity's scope tab
new: Clicking 'Show all N' opens that record type's tab

old: Groups appear in the fixed order Work Orders, Customers, Assets, Parts, Vendors, Part Sales, Purchase Orders, Vendor Invoices
new: Result groups always appear in the same fixed order

old: Group order follows the v2 eight-entity sequence; pinned top hit above groups
new: An exact number match sits above the result groups, which keep their order

old: A Work Order result row shows number + customer, status badge, and unit + year/make/model
new: A Work Order result shows its number, customer, status and unit

old: A Part result shows description, part number and a quantity chip colored by stock level
new: A Part result shows its description, number and stock-coloured quantity

old: A VIN / serial number requires an exact match after normalization
new: A VIN or serial number must match exactly (capitals and spaces ignored)

old: A part number requires an exact match after normalization
new: A part number must match exactly, a wrong digit finds nothing

old: Typos in identifier fields do NOT return fuzzy matches
new: A typo in a VIN, part number or work order number finds nothing

old: A soft (fuzzy) match is visually indicated
new: A close (misspelled) match is marked as close on its row

old: A Part Sale P-number requires an exact match (no fuzzy typo tolerance)
new: A Part Sale P-number must match exactly, a typo finds nothing

old: A very short query does not produce noisy fuzzy matches
new: A very short search does not return loosely matching results

old: A Purchase Order number and a Vendor Invoice number require an exact match (no fuzzy tolerance)
new: Purchase order and vendor invoice numbers must match exactly

old: A clearly unrelated query returns no close (fuzzy) match
new: A clearly unrelated search returns no close matches

old: On a Customer page, that customer's assets and work orders are boosted
new: On a Customer page, that customer's assets and work orders come first

old: On a Work Order page, parts already on that work order are pushed down
new: On a Work Order page, parts already on that work order appear lower

old: A contact-field match scores as a secondary-field match on its company
new: A company found through its contact ranks below one found by its name

old: A prefix name match ranks above a whole-word match, which ranks above a fuzzy match
new: Names starting with the search rank above whole-word, then close, matches

old: Prefix name match ranks above a whole-word match with all other signals held equal
new: A name starting with the search ranks above a whole-word match

old: An exact identifier match is pinned at the very top even when a strong name match exists
new: An exact number match stays at the top even above a strong name match

old: First-time empty state shows the placeholder and a single helper line (no quick-create buttons)
new: First open shows the placeholder and one helper line, no create buttons

old: Recent activity mixes different entity types using the same row template
new: Recent activity lists different record types in the same row style

old: Recent-entities API records views and serves a deduped, permission-filtered list
new: Opened records appear once in recent activity, only if you can access them

old: Results are limited to the signed-in user's own tenant
new: Results show only your own organization's records

old: An entity type with no accessible records shows no group (and its scope tab shows the empty state)
new: A record type you cannot access shows no group, and its tab is empty

old: Permission bundles hide whole groups, their counts and tabs; prices masked without financial access
new: Missing permissions hide groups, counts and tabs, and prices too

old: A user WITH Vendor & Order Management access sees Vendor, Purchase Order and Vendor Invoice results
new: Vendor & Order Management access shows vendors, POs and vendor invoices
